dedupe_keys.name: relacao de empreendimentos de mini e micro geracao distribuida

description: Relação de empreendimentos de Mini e Micro Geração Distribuída is a dataset listed in Brazilian electricity regulator open data portal (ANEEL), an open data portal, published or maintained by Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica. O presente documento trata de dados referentes às conexões de microgeração e minigeração distribuída (MMGD) por meio de unidades consumidoras, conforme regulamentado no art. 655-W da Resolução Normativa ANEEL 1.000/2021. Coverage: Brasil. The portal files it under the publisher Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica. Its tags are CGH, EOL, GD, MMGD, UFV. It offers 12 resource(s) in CSV, PARQUET, PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licença Aberta para Bases de Dados (ODbL) do Open Data Commons. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-repos-br-aneel.
